summary: Iteration 16 full test: 35 pytest cases (all passed) covering integrated-bank-account guards (banking/tx, virman, expense pay, loan installment), bank connection create/sync (simulated), advanced matching (cash-box virman / contact+invoice / category-only), unmatch reversal, match rules with target_account_id, auto-match + connection auto_match flag, bank account delete retest, custom roles CRUD (template copy, rename, bulk permissions, delete, system-role protection) and company location endpoints. Frontend Playwright: /banking?tab=connections (Banka Bağla modal hides integrated accounts, auto-match toggle, unmatched row 4 modes, virman match, matched list + unmatch, rules panel), /banking accounts tab (ENTEGRE badge x2, virman modal excludes integrated accounts, EŞLEŞTİ/EŞLEŞME BEKLİYOR badges, credit-card statement modal empty state with no DOM-nesting errors), /settings roles tab (create with template, rename, perm-all-view/edit/none, delete), /settings company location (Leaflet 10 tiles loaded, marker + radius circle, map-click pending box cancel/save, address search Kadıköy restore) and export buttons on /invoices, /contacts, /orders, /expenses with real CSV download events. All test-created data (2 bank connections, 9 simulated bank_sync txs, 3 match rules, credit-card test account, test role/expense/loan) was removed and every account balance restored to its original value (bank_01 249812.50, bank_02 182407.50, bank_03 26200.99, bank_04 96250.00). Company location left at Kadıköy as requested.

minor.issue: _assert_editable_tx only blocks source 'bank_sync'/'partner'; the auto-created counter transaction (source='bank_match') is still manually deletable/editable, which would orphan the match and leave the bank tx unable to revert the cash balance on unmatch. Consider adding 'bank_match' to the blocked sources.

Runs company-wide over ALL unmatched bank_sync txs of every connection (no connection/account filter), so a rule learned on one bank silently posts matches for other banks' transactions. Consider an optional account_id/connection_id filter.

No dedupe/validation that pattern tokens are meaningful — a 1-word generic pattern (e.g. 'ödeme' stripped) or a very short pattern can auto-match unrelated transactions; also match rule hits are incremented twice per auto-match (once in _learn/_auto_match_by_rules loop and once explicitly).

ui_bugs.issue: React DOM-nesting/hydration console error: 'In HTML <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by mixed text + JS expression children inside <option> (e.g. `<option value="">Cari seçin{mode === 'contact' ? ' (boş = sadece onayla)' : ''}</option>` and `{c.name}{tx.suggested_contact_id === c.id ? ' ★' : ''}`). Compute the label into a single string before rendering to clear the warning.

data-testid values are keyed by provider (auto-match-toggle-<provider>, sync-conn-btn-<provider>, delete-conn-btn-<provider>). With two connections from the same provider the testids duplicate; key them by connection id instead.

issues: Excel/PDF export buttons are correctly rendered but permanently disabled while the (empty) list has no rows — expected, but there is no tooltip/hint explaining why they are greyed out.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): build the <option> labels in BankMatchRow (and any other <option> with mixed text+expression children) as a single string to remove the React DOM-nesting/hydration console warning.
OPTIONAL (LOW): key BankConnectionsPanel per-connection testids by connection id instead of provider to avoid duplicates when two connections share a provider.
OPTIONAL: block source='bank_match' counter transactions in _assert_editable_tx so they cannot be deleted/edited independently of the matched bank transaction.
OPTIONAL: allow filtering /api/banking/transactions/auto-match by connection/account so learned rules don't fire across other banks.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4366 lines — banking/matching, reports and company/geo endpoints should be split into routers (banking.py, reports.py) as done for expenses/finance/rbac.

_apply_match/_unmatch mutate account, contact and invoice documents in several independent awaits without a transaction; a mid-flow failure (e.g. contact not found after invoice update) leaves partial financial effects. Validate all referenced documents first, then apply mutations.

list_bank_accounts issues one bank_connections query per company (fine) but returns conn['_id'] as connection_id while every other payload is cleaned via clean_docs — keep the id naming consistent ('id').

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (2 low-priority console/testid nits)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the iteration-16 suite serially: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration16.py -n 0` (classes share module-level state; pytest.ini forces -n 2 which breaks it). ALWAYS run `python tests/cleanup_iteration16.py clean` afterwards — the suite creates bank connections + simulated bank_sync transactions that alter account/contact/invoice balances, and bank_sync txs cannot be deleted through the API (cleanup script uses Mongo directly and reverts balances). API field notes: bank account type field is `type` (not account_type) and POST /api/banking/accounts requires bank_name+account_name; expenses list returns {expenses, summary}; loans list returns {loans, summary}; there is no GET /api/contacts/{id} or /api/invoices/{id} (use list endpoints). Company location was restored to Kadıköy (40.991295, 29.024563, radius 300 m); the pre-test value was 41.104005, 28.812963.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found this round. The only console noise is the React 19 DOM-nesting warning triggered by dynamic expressions rendered as separate children inside <option> elements (the preview instrumentation wraps each expression in a <span>), which is cosmetic/dev-only but pollutes the console on every page that renders BankMatchRow or similar selects.
